Class ExternalVariables

Namespace
TwinSharp.CNC
Assembly
TwinSharp.dll

Reads and writes CNC External Variables (V.E.*) via the SDA variable-by-name interface.

V.E. variables are shared data memory between the CNC NC channel, the HMI, and the PLC. Unlike P-parameters, they persist across M30 and new program starts — values survive the entire lifetime of the ADS connection and are only re-initialised at CNC boot.

Variables must be declared in a .lis ASCII list file configured at CNC start-up (machine integrator responsibility). The HMI accesses them by their short name (e.g. "rotation_angle"); the full NC/ADS name is "V.E.<name>" (channel scope) or "V.E.G.<name>" (global scope — not handled here).

Variable access: SDA port (552), index group 0x122300 + channelNumber. Uses 0x48 (read by name) and 0x4A (write by name) per TF5200 §4.3.5/§4.3.7.
